Contract: OCI image contract: HomeHub supplies the JSON config plus read-only source/config and writable source-state/backup/change/log bind mounts; SourceStatePath stores the source hash-cache MANIFEST.csv outside the read-only source. The one-shot container returns 0 only for a complete run and deposits Windows/POSIX recovery entry points. HomeHub owns mount-identity preflight, scheduling, and NagLight translation around that exit status. See README 'Run as a Linux container'.
